correctness.rationale: In RESULT.md lines 37–60, the centroidal core is exactly {λ_i≥t} in barycentric coordinates. On two different sides the side parameters are independent uniforms. For u≥v and t>0, feasibility requires u>t and λ∈[t/v,1−t/u]; the remaining coordinate is maximized at the upper endpoint. This gives lower v=tu/(u−t), upper v=min(u,(1−2t)u/(u−t)), and the switch at u=1−t, with u≥2t. Integrating twice the resulting widths yields all three logarithms with the stated coefficients. At r=0 the region has area zero; as r→1 the conditional probability tends to one, but same-side chords never hit for r<1 and all hit at r=1. Continuity of the distinct-side law excludes further atoms. The shape bounds follow from 1/3≤Σp_i²<1/2, attained on the first side exactly at equal lengths and approached on the second at (1/2,1/2,0). At r→0 the first integral is O(r²) and the derivative of the second is 2∫_(2/3)^1 u/(u−1/3)du=2(1+log 2)/3; the displayed expression also gives 1−2t+O(t²|log t|) at the other end. The checker and VERIFICATION.md were inspected; recorded Monte Carlo runs corroborate finite instances only and were not rerun or used as proof.
